findings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders for V182: the neutral front and side skirt outline appears more continuous, but the crouch and sit renders still show substantial anterior thigh exposure and skirt panels lifting/folding away from the thighs. The V182 wrap change therefore does not resolve the observed motion silhouette. This is prototype geometry evidence only and does not establish fit.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in the current front, arm-cross, crouch, and sit renders. Their cause is not established by the renders. Visible bodice surface quality remains unacceptable and is a separate blocker from the skirt wrap.

nextAction: Keep V182 rejected. Do not expand the shared skirt wrap further without evidence: its neutral outline improved, but crouch and sit still expose the front thighs and lift the skirt. Next inspect the actual skirt-to-avatar fit and authored side/lap panel coverage at crouch and sit, then make one seam-preserving front coverage or pose-response prototype. Separately identify the bodice gray-patch/hard-facet source before changing bodice geometry or material. Keep visual review, fit, bone/weight, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates mandatory.
